what: Analytics/telemetry is opt-in by default (telemetryEnabled = false in store.ts). Users must explicitly enable with `aide-memory config telemetry.enabled true`. This was a deliberate user decision — matches the "no telemetry phoning home" promise in docs.
why: User explicitly requested opt-in default. The config check looks for telemetry.enabled === true (not === false). Previous default was opt-out which contradicted the local-first privacy messaging.
